notes:
NEW CARDS

Added all 119 OP17 cards, 30 new cards from ST31 through ST36, and 38 newly announced promos with playable mechanics and compressed art. OP17 is also available in Sealed / Pre-Release.

FORMATS

OP17 and ST31 through ST36 are Block 5. The new cards are legal in Ranked, Casual, and Standard Custom matches.

ONLINE AND UI FIXES

Improved player-name and profile-picture synchronization, friend presence, Custom Sealed rematches, and the scrollable update-notes screen.
